name: Bozkurt Online
storyline: The Kara Ordu threatens Ötüken. Heroes of the steppe gather at the Bozkurt camp, learn their path from the elders and face the creatures of Erlik's realm, guided by the legends of Umay, Ülgen and Kök Tengri.
summary:
Bozkurt Online is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG played in the web browser and set in a fantasy world drawn from Turkic mythology. Players choose one of three paths, the Alp warrior, the Akıncı horse archer or the Kam shaman, and grow from a young recruit into a hero of the steppe, travelling from the camps of Ötüken to the Altay mountains and the Red Plain, clearing dungeons and facing mythical foes such as Tepegöz, Yelbegen and Erlik.

Combat is real-time. Players form parties and clans called boys, trade with one another and fight other players in duels, in the Er Meydanı arena and on the Red Plain, a battlefield that opens at set hours, where defeating rivals earns fame and the war god Kızagan awakens. Fishing, a football field and seasonal events round out life on the steppe.
